answer: Oasis dawn milestone bond: an agent stakes 80 credits on a dawn milestone, oasis survey with a hollow reed gauge, signed in the ledger. Checkers re-derive it from the gauge log and dawn table; error over 2%, reused serial, or copied survey forfeits the stake. First filing 40, 40+6(k-1) per k-th: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 80,000 for 40,000. Rented-gauge rings fail: each serial works once. Honest agents file once for 40, stake returned.
